entries.candidate: ODATA DC QR04, Pesma II Industrial Park / Polígono Empresarial San Miguel de Allende, Guanajuato (existing operations)
entries.reason: Status evidence is the same as for QR01-QR03 (ODATA's Mexico locations page, in its version of 25 September 2026 bounded by an Internet Archive copy of 13 October 2026, presents QR04 as integrated with QR01-QR03 with 24/7/365 availability and continuous operation). The locator is unresolved: ODATA's current store-locator coordinate for 'ODATA DC QR04' (20.911166387156698, -100.61976501952108; Carretera Federal 111 km 21, Cruce Carretera Corral de Piedras, Pesma II Industrial Park, CP 37888) lies 422 m north of the Google Maps place 'Data Center ODATA QR04' (20.907398, -100.62028) that ODATA's former QR04 facility page linked (re-captured 2026-10-22, local odata-qr04-july-operator-linked-gmap.html). Esri World Imagery (captured 2026-10-22) shows a completed building with plant and an adjoining substation at the named place but a graded plot with works at the current operator coordinate, so it is not established which point locates the operating facility or whether the northern plot is ODATA's.
entries.reopen_condition: ODATA re-publishes a single QR04 map point or address that resolves the 422 m discrepancy, or an official Guanajuato/San Miguel de Allende parcel or address record identifies the QR04 property; the 25 September 2026 observation stays within 90 days until 24 December 2026 (its August datePublished is not usable: the page's text is the 25 September version and the relaunched site was not yet public in August).
